body:
we also now have create aronautics!

🌟 FARMER CRAFT!

a fun minecraft server with a small and chill Community



🚀 Features

CC: tweaked. for the inner coder in you CC: tweaked adds the ability to put LUA code inside of Minecraft!
JEI: JEI adds cool stuff in the inventory!.
Xaero's world map: a world map mod!.
cool admins: our admins are very cool. 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

if you ask them you might get free stuff.

</details>



🛠️ how to do stuff

how to open the map: Press M


📦 Dependencies & Compatibility

Mod Loader: Fabric
Target Version: Minecraft 26.1.2
Dependencies: this server needs all mods in modpack to work.

🎨 Recommended Add-ons

Enhance your experience by pairing this project with:

1.  Shaders: i have not tried this modpack with shaders but feel free to try!.
2.  Resource Packs: we allow any resource packs that do not give a unfair advantage above others.

❓ FAQ

Q: Can I make teams on farmer craft?
A: Absolutely! ask javaman1234567 when you add a new player to your team you can get free supplies to give to them!

Q: Will you add new mods to farmer craft?
YES WE WILL!

enjoy your time at farmercraft!
